commit dd4fe8c4b7360e471147909b56e28a5071cb353f
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Jun 30 10:44:10 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Mon Jun 30 10:44:10 2025 +1200

    Bug 1974663 - Port bug 1974156: Update macOS SDK. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
index b0cc5de6af1..77a921a3e79 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ macosx64-x64-libotr:
         symbol: TM(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.4.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.5.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "10.15"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64']
@@ -70,7 +70,7 @@ macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
         symbol: TMA64(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.4.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.5.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "11.0"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64-aarch64']
diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
index 89fb1b3c2c6..75c6f7e1986 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ GECKO_PATH=${GECKO_PATH:-"/builds/worker/workspace/build/src"}
 MOZ_FETCHES_DIR=${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR:-"/builds/worker/fetches"}
 UPLOAD_DIR=${UPLOAD_DIR:-"/builds/worker/artifacts"}
 WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-"${HOME}/workspace"}
-MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX14.4.sdk"}
+MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX15.5.sdk"}
 MACOS_TARGET_SDK=${MACOS_TARGET_SDK:-"10.15"}
title: Bug 1974663 - Port bug 1974156: Update macOS SDK. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD
